text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cereal production this year will not be beyond 11 million quintal (1.1 million tonnes) -- a drop of 74 percent compared to last year.
- Official estimates put the cereal crop at 12 million quintal (1.2 million) tonne for the 1996/97 season. Between 700,000 and 800,000 farmers lost their cereal harvests to drought and frost.

- Abdelkader Hachani, leader of the outlawed Islamic Salvation Front (FIS), stands trial before an Algiers criminal court on Monday along with three journalists from Al Khabar newspaper for attempts to undermine state security.
- Bank and insurance workers threaten to strike on Tuesday to pressure for wage increases.
